cards.text: You give Des the last address. He still doesn't write it down.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "That's the pair, then." He's pleased in a way that takes a second to read as pleased. "Two people who'll have something by the weekend."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Archie all right? We go back — years, that. Had a bit of business once, sorted it out ages ago." He says it with the mild warmth of a man recalling a settled account, and moves on before you can ask which business.
You ask who. He tells you the first names and nothing else, and you realise a beat later that he has told you exactly as much as he'd tell anyone about you.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Nobody's ever raided a vein they didn't know about." He says it as a small joke about paperwork. "That's the whole trick. That's it. That's the entire clever bit."
By the end of the week, both patches you found have veins in them and neither of them is yours. You are, apparently, fine with this, which is itself new information.
